### `analysis.getSectorStalker`

**Sector Stalker** — `GET /analysis/stalker/sector`

```ts
client.analysis.getSectorStalker(params: SectorStalkerParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<SectorStalkerResponse>
```

Get sectoral index or stock price movement data within a specific time range.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih kecil atau sama dengan `to`, dengan rentang maksimal 730 hari. |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |
| `base` | query | `"COMPOSITE" \| "SYARIAH" \| "IDXENERGY" \| "IDXBASIC" \| "IDXINDUST" \| "IDXNONCYC" \| "IDXCYCLIC" \| "IDXHEALTH" \| "IDXFINANCE" \| "IDXPROPERT" \| "IDXTECHNO" \| "IDXINFRA" \| "IDXTRANS"` | tidak | `COMPOSITE` | Indeks acuan. `COMPOSITE` (IHSG) menampilkan rotasi antar sektor, sedangkan `SYARIAH` (saham syariah, dibandingkan dengan indeks ISSI) atau indeks sektoral IDX-IC (`IDXENERGY`, `IDXFINANCE`, dst.) menampilkan rotasi saham anggota kategori tersebut. `ISSI` diterima sebagai alias `SYARIAH`. Wajib huruf kapital. |
| `limit` | query | `number` | tidak |  | Jumlah saham maksimal yang ditampilkan. Hanya berlaku jika `base` bukan `COMPOSITE`. |

Filter aktif hanya jika `filter_column`, `filter_operator`, dan `filter_value` dikirim bersamaan. |
| `filter_operator` | query | `"<" \| ">" \| "=" \| ">=" \| "<=" \| "!="` | tidak |  | Operator pembanding untuk filter. Contoh: `filter_column=change&filter_operator=>&filter_value=5` menampilkan saham yang naik lebih dari 5%. |
| `filter_value` | query | `number` | tidak |  | Nilai pembanding untuk filter. Mendukung bilangan desimal dan negatif, mis. `5` atau `-2.5`. |

Return: `SectorStalkerResponse`

Gunakan nilai `rows[].id` dari response `/analysis/financial-statement/{code}` dengan `statement` yang sama; ID yang tidak ditemukan menghasilkan `account_id`/`name` null dengan `amount` 0. |

### `batch.getOrderBook`

**Batch Stock Order Book** — `GET /batch/order-book/{code}`

```ts
client.batch.getOrderBook(code: string, params?: BatchOrderBookParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<BatchOrderBookResponse>
```

Get order book data for multiple stocks at once in a single request (up to 10 codes on the MAX plan, 25 on the ELITE plan).

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | path | `string` | ya |  | Daftar kode saham yang dipisahkan `\|` atau koma, mis. `BBCA\|GOTO\|TLKM`. Maksimal 10 kode (paket MAX) atau 25 kode (paket ELITE) per request. |

| `date` | query | `string` | tidak |  | Tanggal order book historis (`YYYY-MM-DD`), data tersedia mulai `2026-03-25`. Kirim bersama `time`; kosongkan keduanya untuk data realtime. |
| `time` | query | `string` | tidak |  | Jam order book dalam WIB, format `HH:mm` dengan presisi menit. Kirim bersama `date`. |

Return: `BatchOrderBookResponse`

| `market` | query | `"RG" \| "NG" \| "TN"` | tidak | `RG` | Jenis pasar: `RG` = Pasar Reguler, `NG` = Pasar Negosiasi, `TN` = Pasar Tunai. Gunakan `RG` untuk analisis pergerakan harga pada umumnya. Default `RG` bila tidak diisi. |
| `date` | query | `string` | tidak |  | Tanggal data historis (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Kosongkan untuk data realtime hari ini. |

## `client.journals`

Personal trading journal transactions.

| Method | HTTP | Cache | Ringkasan |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`add`](#journalsadd) | `POST /journals` | - | Add Journal Transaction |
| [`list`](#journalslist) | `GET /journals` | ttl | Journal Transaction List |
| [`delete`](#journalsdelete) | `DELETE /journals` | - | Delete Journal Transactions |
| [`getSummary`](#journalsgetsummary) | `GET /journals/summary` | ttl | Journal Summary |

### `journals.add`

**Add Journal Transaction** — `POST /journals`

```ts
client.journals.add(body: AddJournalRequest, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JournalsAddResponse>
```

Add one BUY or SELL transaction to the user's journal and update the portfolio. A BUY adds lots and recalculates the average price (incl. buy fee) for the stock code + broker pair; a SELL reduces lots and records a realized trade (profit/loss) shown in `GET /trades`.

Body: `AddJournalRequest`

Return: `JournalsAddResponse`

### `journals.list`

**Journal Transaction List** — `GET /journals`

```ts
client.journals.list(params: JournalsListParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JournalsListResponse>
```

Get the user's journal transactions (BUY/SELL) dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Return: `JournalsListResponse`

### `journals.delete`

**Delete Journal Transactions** — `DELETE /journals`

```ts
client.journals.delete(body: DeleteIdsRequest, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JournalsDeleteResponse>
```

Delete one or more journal transactions by ID (body `{"id": ["<id>", ...]}`) and reverse their effect on the portfolio: deleting a BUY reduces the position's lots, deleting a SELL returns the lots to the position and removes the related realized trade.

Body: `DeleteIdsRequest`

Return: `JournalsDeleteResponse`

### `journals.getSummary`

**Journal Summary** — `GET /journals/summary`

```ts
client.journals.getSummary(params: JournalsSummaryParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JournalsSummaryResponse>
```

Get a summary of the user's journal transactions dated between `from` and `to` (inclusive): counts and percentages per transaction type, total and average value, and a per-stock recap.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Return: `JournalsSummaryResponse`

## `client.trades`

Personal realized trades.

| Method | HTTP | Cache | Ringkasan |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`list`](#tradeslist) | `GET /trades` | ttl | Realized Trade List |
| [`delete`](#tradesdelete) | `DELETE /trades` | - | Delete Realized Trades |
| [`getSummary`](#tradesgetsummary) | `GET /trades/summary` | ttl | Realized Trade Summary |
| [`getSummaryChart`](#tradesgetsummarychart) | `GET /trades/summary-chart` | ttl | Realized Trade Summary Chart |
| [`updateNote`](#tradesupdatenote) | `PATCH /trades/{id}` | - | Update Realized Trade Note |

### `trades.list`

**Realized Trade List** — `GET /trades`

```ts
client.trades.list(params: TradesListParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<TradesListResponse>
```

Get the user's realized trades (from SELL journal entries) with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), newest first.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Return: `TradesListResponse`

### `trades.delete`

**Delete Realized Trades** — `DELETE /trades`

```ts
client.trades.delete(body: DeleteIdsRequest, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<TradesDeleteResponse>
```

Delete one or more realized trades by ID (body `{"id": ["<id>", ...]}`). Only the realized-trade records are removed; journal transactions and the portfolio are unchanged.

Body: `DeleteIdsRequest`

Return: `TradesDeleteResponse`

### `trades.getSummary`

**Realized Trade Summary** — `GET /trades/summary`

```ts
client.trades.getSummary(params: TradesSummaryParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<TradesSummaryResponse>
```

Get a performance summary of the user's realized trades with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive): profit/loss/BEP counts, totals, win rate, and the best and worst trades.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |

Return: `TradesSummaryResponse`

### `trades.getSummaryChart`

**Realized Trade Summary Chart** — `GET /trades/summary-chart`

```ts
client.trades.getSummaryChart(params: TradesSummaryChartParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<TradesSummaryChartResponse>
```

Get daily chart data of the user's realized profit/loss with a sell date between `from` and `to` (inclusive), with its running total and the comparison index close on the same day. Only days with realized trades are returned, in ascending date order.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal awal periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `to` | query | `string` | ya |  | Tanggal akhir periode (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Harus lebih besar atau sama dengan `from`. |
| `code` | query | `string` | ya |  | Kode indeks pembanding pada grafik, mis. `COMPOSITE`. Bila dikirim kosong (`code=`), setiap tanggal berisi satu baris per indeks. |

Return: `TradesSummaryChartResponse`

### `trades.updateNote`

**Update Realized Trade Note** — `PATCH /trades/{id}`

```ts
client.trades.updateNote(id: string, body: NoteTradeRequest, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<TradesUpdateNoteResponse>
```

Update the note of one of the user's realized trades. Body: `{"note": "..."}` (optional, max 150 characters); when `note` is omitted the note is cleared.

| Parameter | Lokasi | Tipe | Wajib | Default | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | `string` | ya |  | ID transaksi terealisasi, diambil dari field `id` pada response `GET /trades`. |

Body: `NoteTradeRequest`

Return: `TradesUpdateNoteResponse`
